**版本日期**：2026-11-01（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定源码支持注入、标签分区和过期租约处理；未运行目标、核验部署、账单或安全性。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：需要偶尔访问多供应商工具、或团队共享受控凭据的 Agent 开发者；直连单一供应商是基线。[Q01](#research-q01) - **亮点**：将目录、服务端密钥代理、费用与有限幂等结合；DSH Skill/MCP 是入口，服务主体属于根项目。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02) - **思考**：客户端需主动提供 key 且保护有期限；未知结果可能已到达供应商，新 key 可能再次付费。[Q03](#research-q03) - **建议**：未验证假设：在工具选择中连接费用上限、幂等和对账入口，比较现有状态和直连下的误重试、成本与隐私代价。[Q05](#research-q05) 采用建议：选择受控只读任务、核对账单及费用上限，异常时撤销 token 并回退直连。[Q04](#research-q04) ## 核心贡献 将目录、服务端密钥代理、费用与有限幂等结合；DSH Skill/MCP 是入口，服务主体属于根项目。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02) ## 关键质疑 客户端需主动提供 key 且保护有期限；未知结果可能已到达供应商，新 key 可能再次付费。[Q03](#research-q03) ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 未验证假设：在工具选择中连接费用上限、幂等和对账入口，比较现有状态和直连下的误重试、成本与隐私代价。[Q05](#research-q05) 隔离账户核对服务版本、上游账单、同 key 重试、过期、响应丢失和退出。 ## 场景与替代办法 需要偶尔访问多供应商工具、或团队共享受控凭据的 Agent 开发者；直连单一供应商是基线。[Q01](#research-q01) 逐家配置账号、API 和密钥；单一稳定供应商直连更简单。[Q01](#research-q01) ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Treg 服务与团队 token | 调用必需 | 鉴权和代理 | 无法调用 | | 上游权限及余额 | 相应端点必需 | 外部服务 | 可能拒绝或收费 | | 预算与数据许可 | 试用条件 | 管理费用与中转 | 不发送敏感任务 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 确定预算与凭据 | 配置 token | | 调用 | 用非敏感只读任务 | 核对实际结果 | | 恢复 | 查询 call_id 和账单 | 未知结果不盲换 key | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 服务、供应商费用未知 | 权限及预算配置 | 作者价格未核验 | | 持续 | 上游及平台可能收费 | 账单和结果核对 | 节约未对照 | | 恢复 | 调用可能已收费 | 查询状态并对账 | 超时不代表未执行 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 凭据接线 | 服务端 binding 注入 | 实际安全性 | | 重复调用 | 有效期内的标签复用 | 所有场景恰好一次 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：固定 Treg 根项目的网关价值、凭据注入、幂等和计费恢复边界是什么？ ### Q01 · 谁需要统一工具网关，与直连和 DSH 入口有何区别？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势、依赖、兼容与流程 #### 完整回答 Treg 面向需要偶尔使用多个外部 API、或共享已有供应商凭据的 Agent 团队；它提供目录、代理、组织凭据和费用路径。相对逐家登录、手工集成和分发密钥，集中入口可能降低重复接线；单一稳定 API 直连更简单。README 的供应商订阅价格、赠额和节省是作者声明而非本轮核验现价。DSH 入口只发布 Skill 并配置 MCP，不能把网关服务贡献归于插件壳。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[README.md:5-15](https://github.com/superdesigndev/treg/blob/2fd1bb46626b84c9180e7ca96271b105789e212c/README.md#L5-L15) 作者描述工具目录和目标。
查看原文（11行） ```text **OpenRouter, but for agent tools instead of models.** Point an agent at one base URL with one token and it can do the job: **a curated catalog of thousands of endpoints across many providers** — SEO and backlinks, social and trends, people and company enrichment, ads, scraping, image and video generation — **priced per call, from a cent**, with no provider signup. Plus your own team's keys, skills and CLIs, callable by every teammate's agent without the credential ever leaving the server. **Ask for the task, not the tool.** You do not need to know which vendor sells backlink data, or to hold an account with them. Search for what you want to do, read the price, call it. Built for the Superdesign team, live at [treg.to](https://treg.to) — anyone can self-host. ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[README.md:24-44](https://github.com/superdesigndev/treg/blob/2fd1bb46626b84c9180e7ca96271b105789e212c/README.md#L24-L44) 作者区分目录与自有凭据。
查看原文（21行） ```text ## Two kinds of tool, one token - **The catalog** — external endpoints treg can serve with its own key or through a verified public route that needs no provider key. Own-key calls use the team's prepaid balance; anonymous calls are free. No account with the provider is needed. New verified accounts receive **$1.00 free** once, when they create an eligible team. - **Your own tools** — anything a teammate registered: a paid API account, an OAuth connection, a vendor CLI, a `SKILL.md`. **Your own key always wins over treg's, and those calls are never metered.** The vocabulary for the second half: - **tool** = something the registry calls for you with the org's credential. Two kinds: - **endpoint** — an upstream `base_url` + credential **bindings** (each binding injects one secret into the request; a request can carry several, e.g. an OAuth bearer *and* a `developer-token` header). - **CLI** — a vendor binary (`stripe`, `gh`, `vercel`, ...) run with the credential injected. - **skill / bundle** = a recipe (`SKILL.md`) + its secrets + its tool(s), registered together. **The one rule:** the proxy **relays, never models** the upstream, and **injects auth server-side** — so it survives upstream API changes and callers never hold keys. ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[dsh/index.js:1-18](https://github.com/superdesigndev/treg/blob/2fd1bb46626b84c9180e7ca96271b105789e212c/dsh/index.js#L1-L18) DSH Skill 和 MCP 为独立行。
查看原文（18行） ```text /** * treg as a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin. * * Registers one `ctx.skills` provider that publishes the generated * `dsh/skills/treg/SKILL.md`. The MCP connector is NOT here: it is a separate * row in `cordis.patch.yml`, disabled until `TREG_TOKEN` exists, so the skill * still installs and reads with no token at all. * * Two constraints on this file, both load-bearing: * * - **Plain ESM, no build step.** `dsh plugin add github:...` fetches sources * rather than build output, and pnpm refuses to run a git dependency's * `prepare` script until the user allowlists it - so a compiled bundle would * fail every first install. * - **No `@deepseek-ai/*` dependency.** An out-of-tree bundle depending on an * in-box package installs a second copy that drifts from the host's. The * provider's `list`/`get` contract is the stable seam, so it is implemented * directly here - the shape `dsh-skill-badge` uses for its own skill. ```
**依据 4 · 源码核查**：[dsh/cordis.patch.yml:21-34](https://github.com/superdesigndev/treg/blob/2fd1bb46626b84c9180e7ca96271b105789e212c/dsh/cordis.patch.yml#L21-L34) Token 缺失禁用 MCP。
查看原文（14行） ```text name: treg-dsh # The expression may NOT begin with `!`: YAML reads a second `!` after the # `!!js` tag as another tag property and the whole file fails to parse # ("duplication of a tag property"), taking the profile down with it. - id: treg-mcp name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' disabled: !!js (process.env.TREG_TOKEN ?? '') === '' config: serverName: treg transport: streamable-http url: https://treg.to/mcp/ headers: Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.TREG_TOKEN}`' ```
#### 缺口 - 尚未运行服务、DSH 或真实计费请求 **影响**：不能证明线上可用、准确收费或任务收益 **进一步探讨**：用非敏感隔离账户对照直连并核对供应商账单 ### Q02 · 请求怎样注入凭据，上游隔离依赖什么？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 对 HTTP relay，服务端按 binding 选择 secret，解密后向请求头、参数或 JSON 注入；绑定异常中止。上游共享凭据的 idempotency key 按组织与 pin 改写，以避免上游将不同租户相同标签合并；本地请求还按 membership、primary tag 和 pin 限定，fingerprint 包含方法、路径、查询和 body。请求内容与真实密钥仍经过服务和上游；这是信任转移而非隐私或安全认证，也不覆盖所有 CLI 本地执行路径。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/treg/infra/upstream/relay.py:99-125](https://github.com/superdesigndev/treg/blob/2fd1bb46626b84c9180e7ca96271b105789e212c/src/treg/infra/upstream/relay.py#L99-L125) 共享上游 key 按组织和 pin 分区。
查看原文（27行） ```text def scope_shared_idempotency_key( raw_headers: tuple[tuple[bytes, bytes], ...], org_id: int, *, pinned_tags: dict | None = None, ) -> tuple[tuple[bytes, bytes], ...]: """Rewrite 4 of the faithfulness contract: partition the caller's idempotency label by org and enforced pin. Only for calls on treg's shared provider key. The value is an opaque, fixed-length digest of (org, pin, label): distinct pins do not share a provider dedupe entry. With no pin, the existing (org, label) digest is preserved. The same scope retrying the same label still hits the provider's own dedupe should treg's replay window miss it. """ scope = f"{org_id}\x1f".encode() if pinned_tags: scope += b"pins:" + json.dumps(pinned_tags, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode() + b"\x1f" return tuple( (k, hashlib.sha256(scope + v).hexdigest().encode()) if k.lower() == _IDEMPOTENCY_HEADER else (k, v) for k, v in raw_headers ) _DROP_RESPONSE = _HOP_BY_HOP _TREG_COOKIES = frozenset({"treg_session", "treg_oauth_state"}) # our cookies, scrubbed from Cookie def _scrub_treg_cookies(headers: httpx.Headers) -> None: """Drop treg's own cookies from the forwarded Cookie header so a dashboard `credentials:'include'` call never leaks our session token upstream. Other caller cookies are kept; an emptied header is removed.""" cookie = headers.get("cookie") ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/treg/infra/upstream/relay.py:195-223](https://github.com/superdesigndev/treg/blob/2fd1bb46626b84c9180e7ca96271b105789e212c/src/treg/infra/upstream/relay.py#L195-L223) binding 选取、解密、注入和失败处理。
查看原文（29行） ```text # Apply every binding (a request may need several credentials at once). for binding in tool.bindings: # A PLATFORM binding injects one of treg's own credentials (Google Ads' developer token), # read from settings rather than an org secret. Keeping it out of the org's secret store # matters: it's treg's credential, not the tenant's, so it must not be readable by them or # extractable through a local run. setting = binding.get("platform_setting") if setting: value = get_settings().platform_credential(setting, binding.get("account")) if not value: raise GatewayFailed( "injection_failed", status_code=502, detail=f"this server has no {setting} configured") try: injectors.inject(headers, params, binding, value, json_body=json_body) except ValueError as exc: raise GatewayFailed( "injection_failed", status_code=502, detail=f"credential injection failed: {exc}") from exc continue secret = secrets[binding["secret_id"]] raw = crypto.decrypt(secret.value) try: injectors.inject(headers, params, binding, raw, json_body=json_body) except ValueError as exc: raise GatewayFailed( "injection_failed", status_code=502, detail=f"credential injection failed: {exc}") from exc ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[src/treg/application/call/idempotency.py:55-80](https://github.com/superdesigndev/treg/blob/2fd1bb46626b84c9180e7ca96271b105789e212c/src/treg/application/call/idempotency.py#L55-L80) 本地标签按 primary tag 和 pin 分区。
查看原文（26行） ```text def _scoped_idempotency_key( key: str, meta: CallMeta, *, pinned_tags: dict | None = None, ) -> str: """The caller's label, PARTITIONED by the primary tag. A reselling builder runs every one of their users through one token, so two of them will both reach for `retry-1` — and `IdempotentCall` is unique on (membership_id, key), which would serve the second user the FIRST one's stored response body. That is the cross-tenant leak the table was built to prevent, reappearing one level down. Folding the value into the stored key partitions retries exactly as widening the unique constraint would, with no migration: `uq_idem_caller_key` is declared in `__table_args__`, so SQLAlchemy emits it as a table CONSTRAINT inside CREATE TABLE — Postgres could drop it, sqlite could not without rebuilding the table. Every access site keeps querying by (membership_id, key) and simply receives this value. The primary caller-asserted dimension still partitions unpinned callers. An enforced pin is additionally part of the namespace: changing any pin must not expose an earlier cached body. """ if not key: return key scoped = f"{meta.primary_val}{_IDEM_SCOPE_SEP}{key}" if meta.primary_val else key if pinned_tags: pins = json.dumps(pinned_tags, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) return f"pins:{pins}{_IDEM_SCOPE_SEP}{scoped}" return scoped ```
**依据 4 · 源码核查**：[src/treg/application/call/idempotency.py:88-108](https://github.com/superdesigndev/treg/blob/2fd1bb46626b84c9180e7ca96271b105789e212c/src/treg/application/call/idempotency.py#L88-L108) 指纹包含 method、path、query、body。
查看原文（21行） ```text def _request_fingerprint(method: str, rest: str, body: bytes, query: str = "") -> str: """What the label was used FOR, so reusing it on a different request can be caught. A client that reuses one label for two different requests has a bug. Quietly returning the first answer would hide it, and the caller would be left wondering why their second call returned somebody else's data. Refusing loudly is the useful behaviour, and it is what Stripe does. The QUERY STRING is part of the request. It was missing here at first, and since most catalog calls are GETs that carry all their arguments in the query, that made the check almost inert: two genuinely different lookups under one label matched, and the second was answered with the first one's data instead of the 422 this function exists to raise. """ h = hashlib.sha256() h.update(method.upper().encode()) h.update(b"\0") h.update(rest.encode()) h.update(b"\0") h.update((query or "").encode()) h.update(b"\0") h.update(body or b"") return h.hexdigest() ```
